description: Code-aware static site generator that resolves directive blocks in Markdown templates into live content extracted from source code.

features.title: Code-Aware Directives
features.description: Embed live API references, schemas, tests, and CLI help directly from source code. Content stays in sync automatically.

features.title: Multi-Language Support
features.description: Extractors for Go, Python, TypeScript, Svelte, Zig, Dart, Kotlin, Swift and SQL feed the same directive vocabulary, so one template works across a polyglot repository.

features.title: One Static Binary
features.description: Written in Go and distributed as a single executable. No runtime, no virtualenv, no JavaScript toolchain -- install it with `go install`, npm, or pip and run it.

features.title: SEO & AI Optimized
features.description: Structured data, meta tags, sitemaps, llms.txt, Atom feeds, and 50+ SEO best practices built into every generated page.

features.title: Themeable & Accessible
features.description: Two built-in themes with dark mode, WCAG AA contrast, print stylesheets, and full keyboard navigation.
